info.prompt: Twenty obsidian monoliths levitating in a hexagonal formation, each engraved with glowing runes representing game genres—the central "Horror" monolith dripping viscous shadow that pools into the grid below while "Roguelike" fractures into prismatic shards mid-air, connected by crackling synaptic bridges that thrum with #c8d400 and #3388ff plasma against a backdrop of infinite recursive equations.
